project_type: NestJS 12 modular monolith with TypeScript ESM, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Prisma, Redis/BullMQ
build_system: npm with NestJS CLI, requires .js extensions in imports for ESM compatibility
test_framework: vitest with globals enabled, tests in src/**/*.spec.ts, uses vi.fn() for mocks
test_command: npm test (runs vitest on all src/**/*.spec.ts files)
verification_instructions: After each feature: run 'npm run build' to verify TypeScript compilation passes, then 'npm test' to verify all unit tests pass. The 'npm run check' script runs lint, build and tests together.
environment_constraints: Project uses ESM with .js extensions in imports. Injectable services use @Injectable() decorator and must be provided in a module. The Clock service must be injectable for test control. Node.js crypto module is available (no external crypto dependencies needed).
contribution_requirements: Every business value must be configurable (not hard-coded). Money must be integer kobo (no floats, INV-015). Time must use injectable Clock for testability. Phone numbers normalized to E.164 on input. All primitives require comprehensive unit tests covering edge cases. Tests must include invalid inputs.
key_patterns: Tests use vitest describe/it/expect with beforeEach setup and vi.fn() mocks. DomainException used for business errors with stable codes from src/common/constants/error-codes.ts. Services are @Injectable() and registered in a module's providers array. Global modules use @Global() and @Module() decorators, exported via exports array.
relevant_files: package.json (existing dependencies: no date-fns, no uuidv7 package)
directory_structure: src/ contains domain modules plus common/ (constants/, decorators/, exceptions/, filters/, guards/, interceptors/, pipes/, types/, utils/). common/utils/ is currently empty (.gitkeep only). Tests live alongside source files as *.spec.ts. Configuration in src/config/, database abstractions in src/database/.
